entry.title: MoonClaw remediation-margin closeout action task for First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
entry.summary: needs-review closeout action task consumes NoConsumeCycleClosedForPolicy after 2 refresh cycles with 3 terrain/horizon/energy blockers (refresh-terrain-northeast-stepout, refresh-illumination-northeast-stepout, refresh-energy-window) over margins (terrain-northeast-stepout, illumination-northeast-stepout, energy-window); actions terrain=EscalateToOperatorDecision, local-horizon=RetryWithNewEvidence, energy=FreezeUntilNewSourceEvidence; simulation simulation-blocked, may consume false, hardware authority moonmoon-safety-gate-only at hardware-denied

closeout_actions.required_evidence: operator-reviewed DEM slope and roughness evidence before another terrain refresh
closeout_actions.command: manual: review DEM slope/roughness evidence for terrain-northeast-stepout before any terrain refresh is retried
closeout_actions.reason: terrain blocker terrain-northeast-stepout remains tied to refresh-terrain-northeast-stepout after the first refresh and follow-up refresh projections; disposition EscalateToOperatorDecision prevents an unbounded refresh loop

closeout_actions.required_evidence: new local-horizon or ephemeris evidence before retrying the horizon refresh
closeout_actions.reason: local-horizon blocker illumination-northeast-stepout remains tied to refresh-illumination-northeast-stepout after the first refresh and follow-up refresh projections; disposition RetryWithNewEvidence prevents an unbounded refresh loop

closeout_actions.required_evidence: new power-window source evidence or rover energy profile before unfreezing energy
closeout_actions.command: manual: keep energy-window frozen until new power-window source evidence or rover energy profile is attached
closeout_actions.reason: energy blocker energy-window remains tied to refresh-energy-window after the first refresh and follow-up refresh projections; disposition FreezeUntilNewSourceEvidence prevents an unbounded refresh loop

acceptance_criteria.description: Task source id, closeout status, refresh-cycle count, blocker ids, and no-consume simulation state match the durable MoonRobo closeout policy.
Task carries exactly one operator-reviewable action for each terrain/horizon/energy retry, escalate, or freeze disposition.
Hardware state remains HardwareDenied under moonmoon-safety-gate-only while the closeout action task is under review.

primary_task.safety_gate: This task may schedule only the explicit retry, escalation, and freeze actions from the closeout policy; it must not emit another automatic follow-up refresh loop or authorize MoonRobo simulation consumption.
primary_task.next_action: Review the terrain escalation, horizon retry-with-new-evidence, and energy freeze actions in one operator pass before any new MoonClaw remediation task is emitted.
